subject: Q2 Project Update & Next Steps — Need alignment by EOD
body:
Hi Alex,

Quick update on Project Falcon. The design phase is running 4 days behind because the Figma vendor missed the handoff. To stay on track for the July 15 launch we need to either (a) pull Maya off the marketing site or (b) approve overtime for the design team.

Can you confirm which option you prefer by EOD today? Sarah from Legal also flagged that the privacy review needs to wrap by Friday.

Thanks,
Rohan

subject: Budget Review — Marketing Initiative (approval needed)
body:
Hi Alex,

Attached is the revised Q2 marketing budget. The total ask is $148K (up from $120K) — the increase covers the LinkedIn paid pilot we discussed and the new explainer video.

I need your approval by tomorrow EOD so finance can process before the cycle closes. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if easier.

Best,
Neha

subject: Client Feedback — Acme Portal prototype
body:
Alex,

The team reviewed the portal prototype yesterday. Overall feedback is positive — the dashboard layout works well and the search is much faster.

A few minor UI notes (not blockers):
- Filter chips wrap awkwardly on tablet
- Export icon is hard to spot
- Would love a dark mode in v2

No action needed from your side right now, just keeping you in the loop.

Arjun

subject: Team Offsite — Agenda & dietary preferences
body:
Hi team,

Quick reminder that the offsite is July 18-19 in Bangalore. Please reply with:
1. Any dietary restrictions
2. Whether you'll join the Friday evening dinner
3. Preferred session for the Sat morning breakout (AI strategy / Customer journey / Hiring)

Thanks!
Sneha

subject: URGENT: DPA signature required — Acme x Falcon deal
body:
Alex,

The Data Processing Agreement for the Falcon contract is sitting in your DocuSign queue. Client legal said they cannot countersign the MSA until our DPA is executed.

This is blocking $340K ARR. Please sign today.

— Sarah
